name: Can you repair a deck that has dry rot?

mainEntity.name: Can you repair a deck that has dry rot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we can repair decks affected by dry rot. Dry rot is a serious issue that compromises wood integrity, so addressing it promptly is crucial. Our process involves carefully identifying and removing all affected wood, treating surrounding areas to prevent further spread, and replacing damaged sections with new, treated lumber. We ensure the repaired structure is sound and durable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, we repair decks with dry rot by removing affected wood, treating the area, and replacing damaged sections with new lumber.
